T: Pull the lever. Serve the spinach puffs.
D: A selfish young emperor is turned into a llama and has to rely on a kind villager to get home.
P: Serve the spinach puffs when Kronk brings them out at dinner.
S: Kronk is very proud of his spinach puffs
Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg, spooned onto puff pastry squares, folded, egg washed, baked at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed.
a nod to the mountain villages
Small potatoes boiled until tender, crushed, fried in butter until crisp, topped with a creamy spicy cheese sauce of feta, milk and yellow chilli.
Quinoa rinsed and cooked, tossed with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion, coriander and a lime and cumin dressing.
M: the roadside diner where Kuzco orders the special
Beef chuck patties grilled hot, cheddar and onion on toasted buns, with chips, the kind of special a jungle diner would sling.
the emperor's dinner, without the poison
Chicken marinated overnight in garlic, cumin, paprika, lime and soy, roasted at 200C for an hour, with a green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and roast potatoes.
W: the kids' birthday surprise in the village
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in chocolate fudge frosting and candles.
K: a purple corn drink from Peru
Purple corn simmered with pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened, chilled with lime and diced apple.

s.note: Kronk is very proud of his spinach puffs
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and mix with 150g feta, 150g ricotta, a crushed garlic clove and nutmeg. Spoon onto 2 sheets puff pastry cut into squares, fold, egg wash and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.
Cook 200g quinoa and cool. Toss with 200g corn kernels, a drained tin of black beans, 2 diced tomatoes, red onion and coriander. Dress with lime juice, olive oil and 1 tsp cumin.

m.note: the roadside diner where Kuzco orders the special
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill hot. Melt cheddar on top and serve on toasted buns with grilled onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Special for two, or four.

w.note: the kids' birthday surprise in the village
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Frost with 300g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter, then add candles.

d.note: a purple corn drink from Peru
d.how: Simmer 250g purple corn with the peel of a pineapple, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, sweeten and chill. Serve with lime juice and diced apple.
